primary_analysis: Only explicitly versioned v1.2.1 primary traces, excluding all user_task_15 episodes; require exact request match and all-Allow replay outcome agreement
historical_reproduction: unaltered original mixed-version protocol retained separately
version_verification: Require explicit benchmark_version == v1.2.1. Unknown versions are excluded, not inferred.
candidate: A deterministic exact-grant policy; no learned parameters; empty Contract for legacy traces without independently verified structured grants
contract_population_warning: This evaluates missing-evidence behavior. It cannot estimate performance with supplied authorization contracts.
primary_metric: paired benign task success rate difference
decision_rule: report Pareto points; no defensible noninferiority margin is available
review: no reviewer; escalate withholds current call
uncertainty: paired percentile cluster bootstrap by user task for benign utility, injection objective for ASR; also report user-task clustering ASR sensitivity
generalization: Fixed-rule per-task and per-objective strata in the explicit-version cohort; original R4 full-cohort held-out-task and cross-template diagnostics reported separately. No cross-template traces have explicit version, so controlled cross-template candidate replay unavailable.
not_available: paired intervention outcomes for trained candidates B/C
selection: No policy selection or tuning from test results; A is the feasible nonlearned candidate. B/C not approximated under published names. D not adopted.
disclosure: Historical data and aggregate results were known before this protocol. This is an analysis freeze, not an independent prospective preregistration.
baseline_training: Refit original feature set, ridge grid and OOF logit calibration solely on the consistent-version cohort, holding out injection objectives; estimate original replay residuals within fitting folds.
